summary: Integrate AbortSignal with Fetch so pre-abort and in-flight abort reject with the signal reason and cancel associated work/body as specified.

semantics.pre_aborted: fetch rejects without proceeding with ordinary fetch completion
semantics.in_flight: abort propagates through fetch controller and body consumption
semantics.ordering: abort algorithms/event and promise rejection ordering must follow DOM/Fetch

references: WHATWG Fetch Standard fetch abort steps

tests.name: pre-aborted fetch rejects
tests.input: const c=new AbortController(); c.abort("stop"); try { await fetch("data:text/plain,x",{signal:c.signal}); } catch(e) { console.log(e); }

tests.name: request signal follows source abort
tests.input: const c=new AbortController(); const r=new Request("data:text/plain,x",{signal:c.signal}); c.abort(); console.log(r.signal.aborted);
